description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ValidationException' for handling validation errors within the OrangeHRM system. It extends the PHP built-in 'InvalidArgumentException' and adds additional properties and methods to store and manipulate validation input data and rules.

classes.name: ValidationException
classes.description: Custom exception class for validation errors, encapsulating the input, validation rule, and error message.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ValidationException with input data, the validation rule that failed, and an optional message.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Returns the input data that caused the validation exception.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Sets or updates the input data associated with this exception.

methods.name: getRule
methods.description: Retrieves the validation rule related to the exception.

methods.name: setRule
methods.description: Sets or updates the validation rule for this exception.
